fusions.name: Alarm Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps every strand strung around you. It deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailed Behind
fusions.desc: Whips the strand you have trailed at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: First Twitch
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 20% for 10 seconds and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Tripline Warning
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 15%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
